ホットドッグから450施設へ：Who really runs the stadium?

Started as a stadium food-and-merchandise business in 2008, Legends became a broad venue-services platform. なぜ、飲食から企画・営業・施設運営まで拡張したのか。This English Mix essay examines its business model, acquisition strategy, cash-flow risks and the 2025 antitrust matter, then connects them to outsourcing, hotels and organizational learning.
